artifacts.summary: Phase 1 re-compiled and relocated to RaySummary/Compose.lean (import cycle forbids Saturation.lean) with the DecidableEq binder consumed; phase 2 decomposed into a compiled general keystone, a general shrink surgery, and a model-A containment lemma that removes the case split at k>=1; phase 3's L exhibited as Nat.card (KType (clSig Fp) k); stale-prose and gate checklist.

next_steps: Plan phases 1-3 per the report's Recommendations; extend file_scope with Trace.lean, scripts/check-evidence-probes.sh, w-soundness-shape-refuted.lean (and Transport.lean + RaySummary.lean if phase 2's general lemmas get their own file); drop KTypeSummary/Saturation.lean.

memory_candidates.content: RaySummary sits above the KTypeSummary root in the import graph (Compose -> SeamMulti -> Seam -> WeakCanonical.KTypeSummary, which imports Saturation.lean); any statement mentioning listSeg must land in Decidability/RaySummary, never in KTypeSummary/*.lean.

To keep a recorded [Fintype sig.preds] [DecidableEq sig.preds] signature without an unusedArguments lint finding, let instance search find Fintype (KType sig k) (normalFormFintype consumes both binders) and use Fintype.card + Nat.card_eq_fintype_card instead of Fintype.ofFinite/classical; lake lint is a CI gate and nolints.json additions are forbidden by LEAN_STYLE_GUIDE.md.

At depth k >= 1, kTypeOf equality against a nonempty constant block listSeg (List.replicate j l) forces a segZ segment to be nonempty and constantly l: k_equiv_monotone to depth 1, then k_equiv_preserves_sentence with .ex (.not (.lt 0 0)) and per-predicate .all (.atom P 0)/.all (.not (.atom P 0)); closes in ~60 lines with axioms [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound].
